tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Corrigendum / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the KPP portal only.

Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid. Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected. The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
As per Government Order NO: FD 884 EXP 12 /2019 Banglore Dated 07-05-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake.

Bidders have to quote and execute the work as per the detailed specification given in Sanctioned estimate and the instructions of the Engineer incharge. The copy of the estimate can be obtained from the Asst. Executive Engineers office, City Corporation Davanagere during Office hours.
All other terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidders should have completed similar nature of service, Supply to City Corporation or any Municipal Council or Government agencies like Government Hospitals or Government Hostels or Government Canteens in any one year among last three years(FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) for 75% percent of the tendered amount
Valid Labor License Certificate from labor department or Appropriate Authority

Achieved in at least one financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.99.00 lakhs Certified turnover certificate issued by the Chartered accountant with UDIN Number with in last three financial years (FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 30.75lakhs Unconditional Credit Lines Letters Of Credit Certificates From Banks Solvency Certificate for meeting the fund requirement etc

Should have registered with Statutory authorities in Karnataka as indicated below and scanned copy of necessary proof such as a.GST of the Service Provider b.Valid Trade License c.Valid License from FSSAI Food Safety and Standards Authority India valid for at least one year from last date of tender date Having valid license from FSSAI is mandatory to qualify in Technical evaluation. Without this the bidder will be rejected
